notes: The PDF text prints several codes with a stray space ('MTT 1 10', 'MTT 1 12', 'MTT 1 15', 'MTT 1 18'); these are read as MTT 110, MTT 112, MTT 115, MTT 118, a text-extraction artifact.

The certificate section prints no outcomes of its own; the outcomes recorded are the Machine Tool Technology program-level list, introduced as applying to 'the degree or certificate program', which this certificate shares.
The shared outcomes list appears to repeat the same three outcomes twice in different wording and refers to sensors and robotics, which may not fit machine tool technology; copied as printed.

Career entry 'machining industry' is taken from the certificate's description ('strongly positioned for employment in the machining industry'); the program description also mentions employment in machine shops, tool rooms, and instrument and experimental laboratories (workplaces rather than careers), not recorded as careers.
The A.S. degree in Machine Tool Technology: Numerical Control Programmer prints the same ten courses and 33 units; only the certificate section was used.
